sentences.text: A hare meets a tortoise on a sunny road.

translations.en: A hare meets a tortoise on a sunny road.
translations.fr: Un lièvre rencontre une tortue sur une route ensoleillée.
translations.es: Una liebre se encuentra con una tortuga en un camino soleado.

sentences.text: The hare is very proud of his speed.

translations.en: The hare is very proud of his speed.
translations.fr: Le lièvre est très fier de sa vitesse.
translations.es: La liebre está muy orgullosa de su velocidad.

sentences.text: He laughs at the slow tortoise.

translations.en: He laughs at the slow tortoise.
translations.fr: Il se moque de la lente tortue.
translations.es: Él se ríe de la tortuga lenta.

sentences.text: The tortoise smiles and asks for a race.

translations.en: The tortoise smiles and asks for a race.
translations.fr: La tortue sourit et demande une course.
translations.es: La tortuga sonríe y pide una carrera.

sentences.text: The hare agrees and laughs again.

translations.en: The hare agrees and laughs again.
translations.fr: Le lièvre accepte et rit encore.
translations.es: La liebre acepta y vuelve a reír.

sentences.text: The race begins in the green forest.

translations.en: The race begins in the green forest.
translations.fr: La course commence dans la forêt verte.
translations.es: La carrera empieza en el bosque verde.

sentences.text: The hare runs ahead very fast.

translations.en: The hare runs ahead very fast.
translations.fr: Le lièvre court devant très vite.
translations.es: La liebre corre adelante muy rápido.

sentences.text: He sees that the tortoise is far behind.

translations.en: He sees that the tortoise is far behind.
translations.fr: Il voit que la tortue est loin derrière.
translations.es: Él ve que la tortuga está muy atrás.

sentences.text: The hare sits under a big tree.

translations.en: The hare sits under a big tree.
translations.fr: Le lièvre s'assoit sous un grand arbre.
translations.es: La liebre se sienta debajo de un gran árbol.

sentences.text: The slow tortoise walks and walks.

translations.en: The slow tortoise walks and walks.
translations.fr: La lente tortue marche et marche.
translations.es: La tortuga lenta camina y camina.

sentences.text: He does not stop to rest.

translations.en: He does not stop to rest.
translations.fr: Elle ne s'arrête pas pour se reposer.

sentences.text: He passes the sleeping hare on the path.

translations.en: He passes the sleeping hare on the path.
translations.fr: Elle dépasse le lièvre endormi sur le chemin.
translations.es: Pasa a la liebre dormida en el camino.

sentences.text: The tortoise reaches the finish line first.

translations.en: The tortoise reaches the finish line first.
translations.fr: La tortue franchit la ligne d'arrivée en premier.
translations.es: La tortuga llega a la meta en primer lugar.

sentences.text: The hare wakes up and cries.

translations.en: The hare wakes up and cries.
translations.fr: Le lièvre se réveille et pleure.
translations.es: La liebre se despierta y llora.

sentences.text: Slow and steady wins the race.

translations.en: Slow and steady wins the race.
translations.fr: Rien ne sert de courir, il faut partir à point.
translations.es: Lento pero seguro se gana la carrera.
